description: Generic SDMX data fetch from any Norges Bank flow. key is dot-separated SDMX dimension filters; leave a position empty to wildcard it. Examples: flow_ref="EXR", key="B.USD.NOK.SP" (daily USD→NOK spot); flow_ref="IR" (all interest-rate series). Use list_flows to see available flow references.

flow_ref.description: Flow reference — EXR, IR, GOVT_KEYFIGURES, GOVT_GENERIC_RATES.

key.description: Series key: dot-separated dimension values (empty positions = wildcard). Optional; omit for the whole flow.

last_n.description: Return only the last N observations.

name: get_series
title: Get Series
